reasoning: The question asks whether the BBB OAS spread will increase from March 15 to March 22, 2026 - a 7-day period. OAS spreads are highly sensitive to market conditions, credit sentiment, and economic data releases. Over a one-week period, spreads can move in either direction based on Fed policy expectations, economic data, corporate earnings, and broader risk sentiment. Without specific knowledge of events occurring between these dates, this is essentially a coin flip with slight considerations: (1) spreads tend to be mean-reverting, (2) there's no strong seasonal pattern favoring increases in mid-March, and (3) the short timeframe means random walk dynamics dominate. Historical volatility suggests roughly equal probability of increases vs decreases over 7 days.
